title: ClickableBroadcast
description: ClickableBroadcast is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that sends automatic broadcast messages to all players. Messages can include clickable links, allowing players to open websites, Discord invites, or other pages directly from chat.
body:
ClickableBroadcast

ClickableBroadcast is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that automatically sends broadcast messages to all players in chat.

Its main feature is the ability to include clickable links in broadcast messages, allowing players to easily open websites, Discord invites, stores, or other important pages directly from the chat.

The plugin is designed to be simple and easy to configure, so server owners can quickly set up automatic announcements without complicated configuration.

Features

📢 Automatic broadcast messages

🔗 Clickable links in chat

⚙️ Simple and beginner-friendly configuration

🧩 Lightweight and efficient
